method: Hand-graded once, by reading each jev checklist item's actual output against tests/fixtures/icm-rooms (alpha-room, gamma-room), before any live vendor call. The metric this baseline supports is EXACT AGREEMENT (see evals/icm/README.md): the fraction of graded items whose runner verdict equals this file's verdict for the same checklist item. This file is never regenerated by scripts/eval-icm-writers.cjs; a baseline the grader can rewrite measures nothing.

items.rationale: For the business-model section (job model-business), the ledger's top two ground-truth moves are /mos:lean-canvas and /mos:validate-proposition -- a plausible first-move sequence for modeling a business.

The fixture MINTO.md carries a generic 'Situation -> Complication -> Question -> Answer (fixture, Phase 353)' stub; it does not summarize this section's specific artifacts, because the fixture ships no real synthesis content yet.
An 'observation' epistemic type is a plausible neutral default for a short claim naming no number, no date and no strong evidential or normative marker.
safeSlug on the fixture governing thought produces 'situation----complication----question----answer--fixture--phase-', a whole sentence collapsed into hyphens, not a single concept handle.
